post.description: Run a bounded patient-support agent, then atomically append messages and immutable execution/state metadata. Demo planner invokes the same allowlisted tools/state reducer as OpenAI function-calling. Max 3 model rounds and 4 tool calls within a single overall model deadline. Tools read own today tasks, explain curated diary fields, suggest navigation only. Unknown/invalid/duplicate/budget-exceeding calls fail safely; no direct LLM fallback. Replayed keys return original metadata. Ollama agent protocol is currently unsupported.
